professional_summary:
A 3D Artist with 5+ years of experience specializing in AR-ready 3D models, environments, props, product visualization, and animation. Expert in creating high-quality, optimized 3D assets and engaging digital experiences across a wide range of projects.

I help businesses bring their products to life through interactive 3D experiences, web-based product configurators, AR-ready assets, and high-quality product animations for marketing and advertising.

From concept to final delivery, I focus on creating high-quality 3D solutions that help businesses showcase their products, enhance their digital presence, and connect with their audience more effectively.

education.qualification: B.Sc in Graphics and VFX - Jain University Bangalore

responsibilities: Created 3D models and converted CAD data into optimized assets for web-based 3D product configurators and interactive visualization.
Worked on modeling, optimization, UVs, materials, and scene setup to ensure smooth real-time performance.
Integrated 3D assets into configurator scenes, enabling customers to interactively visualize and customize products.
Managed multiple client projects under tight deadlines, delivering high-quality work with minimal feedback and fast client approvals.
Created and optimized low-poly 3D assets for real-time Amazon AR experiences.
Worked with scan data to build accurate, production-ready 3D models.
Handled modeling, retopology, UV mapping, and texturing for AR-ready assets.
Optimized geometry and textures while maintaining visual quality and real-time performance.
Worked in a fast-paced and challenging environment, delivering high-quality 3D assets within tight deadlines.
Created diverse 3D environments, props, and assets for educational animated videos.
Translated 2D concepts into visually appealing 3D scenes while maintaining the required style and quality.
Worked closely with the creative team to deliver assets within project requirements and timelines.
